name: MetricOS
notes: Live ISO with Debian Installer live option.
Chrome comes from Google’s official signed APT repository; the build hook verifies the public key fingerprint.
Steam is offered as an opt-in installer to keep the default image smaller and to enable i386 cleanly at install time.
Most control-center preferences persist in the MetricOS user profile; only documented native mappings change KDE or power profiles.
Gamescope is not included because it is not available as a Debian 13 stable package in the checked repository catalogue.
